<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the 110–160 ppm region correspond to aromatic carbons. These are the shifts at 151.10, 144.35, 140.45, 137.05, 131.30 (two signals), 124.40, 122.30, 119.00, and 116.65 (two signals), giving a total of 11 aromatic carbon signals. Assuming each signal represents a distinct aromatic carbon atom, the molecule contains 11 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>11</final_answer>
